title: AES77 Streaming Speech
summary: A monitoring Profile for speech-led internet audio distribution.
descriptionMarkdown: AES77 recommends −18 LUFS Distribution Loudness for speech-led internet audio and a Maximum True Peak no higher than −1 dBTP at the input of a lossy encoder. This Profile uses whole-program Integrated Loudness and is intended for speech-only or strongly speech-dominant material. For assorted content with a separately measurable speech anchor, AES77 instead calls for Dialogue Integrated Loudness with an upper tolerance; PLVS does not claim that this Profile replaces that dialogue measurement workflow. The warning begins above the nominal target rather than encouraging operation at the upper tolerance.

references.title: AES77-2023 Loudness Guidelines for Internet Audio Streaming and On-Demand Distribution
references.relevanceMarkdown: Defines distribution targets, measurement methods, tolerances and the True Peak recommendation for internet audio.

references.title: Loudness Normalization
references.relevanceMarkdown: Explains the −18 LUFS speech target and the distinction between speech-anchor and whole-program workflows.
